preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Input consists of lines of text, where each line is a string.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) >= 1 and all(line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Input is non-empty and contains no empty lines.
First line is a valid integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 100000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line.strip()) == N)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line after T is a valid integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 100000) representing the number of matches.

preconditions.expression: all(len(goals) == N for N, goals_line in zip([int(stdin.splitlines()[i*2+1]) for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]))], [stdin.splitlines()[i*2+2] for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]))]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the goals line contains exactly N integers.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(g) <= 1000000 for goals_line in [stdin.splitlines()[i*2+2] for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]))] for g in goals_line.split())
preconditions.description: Each goal count gi is a non-negative integer (0 ≤ gi ≤ 1000000).

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() in ['UNFIT'] or (stdout_line.strip().isdigit() and int(stdout_line.strip()) > 0) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'UNFIT' or a positive integer representing the maximum goal difference (g_j - g_i > 0 where j > i).

postconditions.expression: all((N < 2 or max((int(goals[j]) - int(goals[i])) for i in range(N) for j in range(i+1, N) if int(goals[j]) > int(goals[i])) <= 0) == (stdout_line.strip() == 'UNFIT') for N, goals_line, stdout_line in zip([int(stdin.splitlines()[i*2+1]) for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]))], [stdin.splitlines()[i*2+2] for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]))], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: If there are fewer than 2 matches (N < 2) or no pair of matches (i < j) exists where goals in match j > goals in match i, output 'UNFIT'. Otherwise, output the maximum positive goal difference (g_j - g_i) for any i < j.
